installation.note: The bundled installer copies shared files and preserves relative links. Some Skills CLIs install one folder only; then add the three shared files manually or use the included installer.

compatibility_note: Agent Skills hosts vary in discovery, references handling, tool access, and execution. Static conformance does not prove identical runtime behavior across clients.
